# P32.16 — Durable anonymous correction intake and private moderation

**Requirement ids:** SIG-FIND-006 (§55.5) ·
**ADR:** ADR-135 ·
**Base:** `devin/p32-15-coordinated-investigation-workspace` (stacked on PR #171 — merge this after #171) ·
**Run:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/176_P32.16__anonymous-correction-intake.md live_verification=false` ·
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/176_P32.16__anonymous-correction-intake.md` (manifest row 176)

## What this does

Delivers the **durable anonymous correction receiver and private moderation
workflow** — the engineering half of §55.5 SIG-FIND-006. A bounded report can
arrive without an account, be stored durably **outside the claim spine**, and
reach a private reviewer queue — while the receiver holds **no** authority to
write canonical claims, review decisions or publication dispositions. The
receiver is **built, not operating**: it cannot accept a report until a named
staffed owner, the retention ratification, provisioned secrets and the
public-exposure decision (GATE-G3) are all satisfied — `D-R10-PUBLISH-1` and
the new `D-P32.16-1` stay OPEN by design.

### Isolated storage + least-privilege roles (`db/deploy/intake_storage.sql`, `db/src/db/intake.py`)

- New `intake` schema: `intake.report` (immutable identity, expungeable
  payload — reports must be redactable/expungeable so they are deliberately
  **outside** both the append-only claim spine and the WORM evidence store),
  `intake.reporter_contact` (restricted side table), `intake.receipt`
  (SHA-256 digests only), `intake.event` (append-only restricted audit log),
  `intake.report_public` (definer-owned coarse projection).
- Two NOLOGIN roles: `sig_intake_receiver` (INSERT payloads + projection/
  digest reads only — column-level, never table-wide) and
  `sig_intake_reviewer` (SELECT payloads + INSERT reviewer events +
  SECURITY DEFINER redact/expunge EXECUTE).
- A `current_setting('role')` writer guard pins `received` to the receiver
  role and reviewer events to the reviewer role; **`applied`/`published` are
  refused for every current role** — reserved for the P32.16a authorized
  bridge. **No existing role holds any intake grant** (read, export, ingest,
  materialize and curation roles all verified negative live).

### The receiver process (`api/src/api/intake.py`, `sig-api serve-intake`)

- A **third separate process** — proven absent on the read API and absent of
  curation routes; the existing curation app stays loopback-only.
- No-JS form + `POST /intake/v1/reports` + `POST /intake/v1/status`, all
  allowlisted through the `intake_receiver.toml` contract table (data, not
  code): expiring signed `form_token` (its nonce doubles as the idempotency
  key, so a reload re-POST is idempotent), category, optional
  `publication_id`/`record_key`, ≤10 public claim ids, a 20–4000-code-point
  narrative, ≤3 public https references (parsed, stored as text, **never
  fetched**), optional legal-demand-only contact.
- **Part VIII screen before persistence** — plate/per-person/per-trip/
  identifying-detail tokens (separator-normalized) plus person-shaped
  patterns refuse the whole report before any row or log entry exists.
- Receipt capability: `rct-<hex32>` + a ≥128-bit one-purpose status token;
  digest-only storage, constant-time compare, POST-body-only (never a URL),
  shown once; uniform `unknown_receipt` 404 — no existence oracle; failed
  lookups rate-limited.
- Abuse control: rotating ≤24 h HMAC pseudonym per normalized ingress
  address (5/h + burst 3, 100/h global circuit breaker); no durable
  IP/UA/cookies; Origin + Fetch-Metadata checks, no CORS, no-store /
  no-referrer / CSP-`none` headers.

### Private moderation (`api/src/api/intake_moderation.py`)

- Mounted **only** on the authenticated loopback curation app and only when
  an intake reviewer store is wired (`serve-curation --intake-dsn`).
- Bounded priority queue + detail + append-only events over the fail-closed
  transition table (`received→triaged→assigned→review_requested→
  disposition_proposed→disposition_approved→closed`); invalid transitions
  409. `disposition_approved` requires `HUMAN_ASSERTION` tier, others
  `VERIFY_SUBMISSIONS`; approvals must name the live proposal.
- Every disposition requires outcome + reason (refusal included); the
  reporter-visible `public_response` is disclosed only when the approver
  flags `public_response_publish`; redaction is audited and irreversible.
- Retention: `sig-api intake-purge` expunges payloads 30 d after final
  disposition under a 90 d review ceiling, skipping `legal_hold` reports
  (dry-run + JSON report).

### Honest public state (`web/src/pages/dispute.astro`, `ops/config.toml`)

- `/dispute/` states the receiver is **built but not yet operating**, names
  its future paths, ships zero forms, and can never advertise an unstaffed
  receiver (`intakeAvailability` is a constant — a static page never probes).
- `ops/config.toml [intake]`: `operational=false`, `owner=""`, `staffed=false`
  committed; accepting reports requires that flag AND `SIG_INTAKE_OPERATIONAL=1`
  AND both env secrets — the code fails closed without them.
- `docs/governance/intake-receiver-operating-packet.md` is the operator
  packet: staffing, retention ratification, provisioning, infra
  identifier-retention exclusions, and the probe plan before launch.

## Deferrals

`D-P32.16-1` **opened** (operating prerequisites: named owner, staffed
rotation, retention ratification, secret/role provisioning, infra
identifier-retention exclusions — cites BL-058; compensating control is the
code-enforced refusal + honest `/dispute/` copy + the committed packet).
`D-R10-PUBLISH-1` annotated — stays OPEN (built ≠ operating; GATE-G3 owns
exposure). `D-R10-SOURCES-1`, `D-R10-HUMAN-1`, `D-R10-USERS-1`,
`D-R10-MEMORY-1`, `D-P32.10a-1` unchanged OPEN. None closed.

## Out of scope honoured

No correction application (`applied`/`published` refused — P32.16a's bridge),
no publication or public exposure, no source-rights flips, no human labels,
no gate signatures, no staffing claims, no uploads/server-side fetches, no
claim-spine writes, no landed-ADR edits, no merge/tag/push-main.
